IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Wednesday 11 November
Winds: West to northwesterly below 10 knots.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Thursday 12 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming south to southeasterly 15 to 20 knots in the early afternoon then tending south to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres, increasing to around 1 metre around midday.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 13 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming east to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the early afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Saturday 14 November
Winds: South to southwesterly below 10 knots increasing to 15 to 20 knots during the morning then becoming west to southwesterly about 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the afternoon.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.

Sunday 15 November
Winds: Northwest to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots becoming southwesterly 20 to 30 knots during the day then tending westerly 10 to 15 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the afternoon.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A ridge of high pressure develops from the west today. This ridge is expected to persist until Friday before it is eroded by a weak trough developing over the state. This trough is forecast to weaken on Saturday before a cold front moves over the state during the day. Cool southwesterly winds are forecast on Sunday as a high approaches from the west in the evening.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Wednesday 11 November
Winds: Westerly 20 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots offshore.
Seas: 2.5 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 1 to 2 metres inshore, increasing to 2.5 to 3 metres offshore.
Weather: Cloudy.

Thursday 12 November
Winds: Westerly 15 to 25 knots.
Seas: 1.5 to 2.5 metres, decreasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning.
Swell: Southwesterly 2.5 to 3 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 13 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots becoming variable about 10 knots in the middle of the day.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to 1 metre during the morning.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2 metres inshore, increasing to 2 to 3 metres offshore.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Saturday 14 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming west to southwesterly 15 to 25 knots during the morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the morning.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 2.5 metres.
Weather: Cloudy. 80% chance of showers.
